Staying hydrated is just as important during the monsoon as it is in summer. Although the weather feels cooler, your body continues to lose fluids through daily activities. Proper hydration helps support normal body functions and overall well-being.

Here are a few simple tips to stay hydrated during the rainy season:

💧 Drink clean, safe drinking water regularly throughout the day.
🥥 Include fluids like coconut water, soups, or fresh fruit with high water content in your diet.
🍉 Eat seasonal fruits and vegetables after washing them thoroughly.
☕ Limit excessive caffeinated or sugary beverages, which may contribute to dehydration.
🧼 Carry a clean water bottle and maintain good hygiene to reduce the risk of waterborne illnesses.

Pay attention to signs such as excessive thirst, dark-colored urine, dizziness, or unusual fatigue, as these may indicate dehydration.

Maintaining healthy hydration habits, eating a balanced diet, and following good hygiene practices can help support your health during the monsoon season.

Common signs of dengue may include:
• High fever
• Severe headache
• Pain behind the eyes
• Muscle and joint pain
• Skin rash

Common signs of viral fever may include:
• Fever with cough or sore throat
• Runny or blocked nose
• General body aches
• Fatigue

If your fever lasts more than two days, becomes very high, or is accompanied by persistent vomiting, unusual bleeding, severe weakness, or difficulty breathing, it is important to seek prompt medical attention.

featured_reviews.review_text:
​I cannot express enough gratitude to Dr. Nikhil for the exceptional care he provided during my high-risk twin pregnancy and delivery. From the very beginning, his calm demeanor and expertise were a sanctuary for me; he truly helped me navigate a stressful period without taking on unnecessary "tension," making me feel safe and informed every step of the way.
​Expert Surgical Care & Innovation
​When it came to my C-section, Dr. Nikhil’s immense experience was evident. He ensured the delivery was smooth and handled with the utmost precision. What truly set my recovery apart was his proactive approach—he utilized a drainage pipe for my stitches, a technique that significantly accelerated my healing process and minimized discomfort. It is rare to find a surgeon who balances technical mastery with such thoughtful post-operative care.
​Compassionate Emotional Support
​Beyond the physical surgery, Dr. Nikhil supported me through one of the hardest emotional hurdles a new mother can face: the guilt of being unable to breastfeed. In a society that places so much pressure on "liquid gold," I was struggling deeply. Dr. Nikhil shared an insightful article he had written on this very topic, which completely shifted my perspective and helped me overcome that guilt.
​Empowering New Mothers
​He didn't just stop at healing me; he empowered me. He encouraged me to share my own journey and write an article to help other struggling new moms. This level of mentorship and advocacy for maternal mental health is what makes him more than just a doctor—he is a true healer.
​I highly recommend Dr. Nikhil to any woman looking for a doctor who combines world-class medical expertise with genuine, life-changing empathy.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m writing this review with a broken heart. My mother-in-law is no longer with us, and I believe DR. SALMAN ALI SAYED (Nephrologist) at this hospital is responsible.
He misdiagnosed her condition - or failed to diagnose it properly at all. Her health deteriorated rapidly under his care. What could have been treated became fatal because of medical negligence.
We trusted this doctor with someone we loved. We believed he would help her. Instead, we lost her.
The rushed appointments, the failure to listen to our concerns, the lack of proper and unnecessary testing - it all added up to a tragedy that didn’t have to happen. This hospital treated her like a SOURCE of REVENUE, not a HUMAN BEING fighting for her life.
She’s gone now. Our family is shattered. And I have to live every day knowing that better care could have saved her.

To anyone reading this:

PLEASE get a second opinion. Ask questions. Demand answers. Don’t trust blindly like we did.

If this review saves even one person from what we went through, then maybe her death won’t be completely meaningless.

We will never get her back. Don’t let this happen to your family.

Ilyaas sir also deserves deep respect for always showing patients the right path with honesty and care.

featured_reviews.name: KB Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cama and Albless Hospital (also called Pestonji Cama & Albless Hospital) is a long-established government hospital in Mumbai that specialises in healthcare for women and children. It is one of the city’s key public referral centres in these areas and operates under the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC).

Location
Address: Mahapalika Marg, opposite Azad Maidan, Dhobi Talao, near Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), Fort, Mumbai 400001, Maharashtra, India.

The hospital is centrally located and easily accessible by train, bus and taxi from across the city.

History & Capacity
The hospital was founded in 1886, making it one of Mumbai’s oldest public healthcare institutions.

It originally started as Cama Hospital and was later renamed Cama and Albless Hospital.

Current bed capacity is around 500+ beds dedicated to women’s and children’s care.

Primary Focus and Services
Healthcare for Women and Children:

Maternity care, high-risk pregnancies and obstetrics

Gynaecology including specialised clinics such as urogynaecology
Paediatric care and neonatal services

Low-cost or subsidised treatment as a public hospital for eligible patients

Oncology and Advanced Care:
The hospital runs an oncology wing with chemotherapy and related services focused on cancers common in women.

Radiation therapy services have been modernised with a linear accelerator machine to provide targeted treatment free of charge for cancer patients, a significant upgrade in public cancer care.

Reproductive Health and ART:
The hospital offers assisted reproductive technology (ART) services, including IVF. Since May 2024 these services have been made available free of cost under the state health insurance scheme for eligible patients, making it the first public hospital in Maharashtra to do so.

In late 2025 it became the first public hospital in the state authorised to provide egg freezing and sperm bank services as part of its ART programme.

Other Developments:
The hospital is adding educational programs such as a postgraduate diploma in oncology nursing to support cancer care training.

A Centre of Excellence for Women’s Pelvic Health has opened to treat urogynaecological conditions, with modern diagnostics and clinic rooms.

Teaching & Referral Role
Cama and Albless Hospital also functions as a teaching and research hospital linked with Grant Medical College and is part of a network of public hospitals that train doctors and healthcare professionals.

Community Role

It serves a wide patient base from Mumbai and nearby districts, offering emergency care 24/7 and referral services for specialised women’s and children’s health needs at subsidised costs.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
---

🌟Cama & Albless Hospital 🌟

Cama and Albless Hospital, located near Mumbai’s CST area, is one of the city’s oldest and most respected government hospitals, especially known for women’s and children’s healthcare. Established in the late 19th century, it has served generations of families with dedication and compassion.

Strengths
- Specialized Care: The hospital is focused on maternity, gynecology, and pediatric services, making it a trusted institution for women and children.
- Affordability: As a government hospital, the cost of treatment is minimal compared to private hospitals. For the fees charged, the services provided can feel like 5‑star value.
- Experienced Staff: Many doctors and nurses here have decades of experience, and their commitment to serving patients is evident.
- Legacy & Accessibility: Centrally located near CST, it is easily accessible to people across Mumbai.

Limitations
- Infrastructure: Being a government hospital, facilities may not match the luxury or comfort of private hospitals. If one expects a 5‑star ambience, it may feel closer to 2‑star.
- Crowding & Wait Times: Like most public hospitals, it can be crowded, and patients may face longer waiting periods.

Overall Impression
Cama and Albless Hospital is a heritage institution that continues to provide essential healthcare to women and children at highly affordable costs. While it may not offer the polished environment of private hospitals, the value for money and the dedication of its staff make it a lifeline for countless families.

Dr. Nitin Pai played a truly vital role in my pregnancy journey, and I am immensely grateful to him 🙏🏻 Only if words could do justice — beyond grateful.

What truly sets him apart is his integrity. He is not someone who runs behind money, which is rare to find today, and for that he holds the highest regard and respect in my eyes.
His calm demeanour — always smiling, patiently listening, and reassuring — made a huge difference, especially during the last leg of my pregnancy. His sharp memory and attention to detail, even with so many patients, is truly commendable. His calm presence in the labour room helped me immensely.
More than the hospital, it is always the doctor who matters during the final phase of pregnancy and the journey of meeting your baby — and Dr. Pai truly embodies this.

The hospital staff was equally supportive, especially Shubhashri  and Anita Madam, who were always helpful and available.

I would blindly recommend Dr. Nitin Pai to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, ethical, and reassuring doctor who guides you through pregnancy seamlessly, without unnecessary drama or complications.
